title: Home & presentation library
description: Presentation carousel, customization, deletion, and import entry.

frames.title: Home · saved presentations
notes: Tap the front icon to open the deck; tap an adjacent icon to center it.
The score ring opens Full review only when the deck has a saved run.
Bottom legend: Spin · Open · Icon · Add · Delete.

frames.title: Home · no presentations
notes: Empty Home shows a new-presentation ghost card.
Tap its icon or pull up to open Add your presentation.

frames.title: Choose an icon

blocks.text: Current icon marked with a dot

notes: The source icon grid includes 20 icon options; this diagram schematically shows a subset.
Selecting an icon saves it and closes the sheet. Backdrop, swipe down, or Android Back closes it.

frames.title: About OutLoud · credits
notes: Opened from the stopwatch brand mark.
Tap backdrop or Android Back to close. The source shows names without a settings menu.

frames.title: Delete presentation · Undo

blocks.text: Pull down · keep holding to delete

notes: The hold gesture deletes the selected deck only when more than one deck remains.
The toast is the immediate post-delete state; Undo restores the hidden deck during its 4.5-second window.
With one deck remaining, the pull hint says Keep at least one presentation.

frames.title: Add your presentation

blocks.text: Upload icon · tap to choose PDF
PDF · up to 50 MiB · any slide count

notes: Tapping the icon opens the native PDF picker, which is operating-system UI.
While opening, the app subtitle reads Opening your files…; canceling the picker returns here.
Swipe down or Android Back returns Home.

title: Import, setup & rehearsal entry
description: PDF processing, presentation time and audience, sync states, and ready view.

frames.title: Import · slides, text, timing

blocks.text: Slide text waits for server when offline

notes: Stages are Slides, Text, Timing; completed stages receive checkmarks.
Percentages and labels reflect the import progress state.
A text-offline notice is conditional; successful analysis opens setup.

frames.title: PDF import failed · choose again

blocks.text: PDF · up to 50 MiB · any slide count

notes: The app returns to its pick phase and shows the actual picker/import error as the subtitle.
There is no dedicated Retry button; tapping the upload icon reopens file selection.

frames.title: Presentation setup · defaults
notes: Initial import defaults to 5:00 and General audience.
The ruler uses 30-second steps. Optional controls clear the required time or target audience.
Save persists choices locally, requests synchronization when possible, and opens Rehearse.
This editor is reused for existing decks; Back closes it to Rehearse. Initial import Back returns Home.

frames.title: Custom audience · input & validation

blocks.text: Do you have a target audience?

notes: Other… reveals a multiline audience field, character counter, and Done control when the keyboard is open.
The viewport scrolls above the keyboard.
Invalid Save says Use a time from 1–30 minutes and an audience of at most 500 characters.

frames.title: Presentation choices · sync conflict
notes: This is the same time/audience editor with a pending revision conflict.
Normal Save is disabled. Use server accepts server choices; Keep mine keeps local choices and requests synchronization.
A non-conflict pending draft instead says Saved on phone · sync pending.

frames.title: Rehearse · ready
notes: Horizontal PDF gestures and folded corners navigate slides; tick strip provides direct approximate jumps.
Review is disabled until a saved run exists.
Swipe down goes Home while idle. Cues header includes selected-slide audio playback when available.

title: Rehearsal & capture states
description: Cue evidence, rotated PDF, countdown, live audio, and completion routing.

frames.title: Cues · expanded details
notes: Each cue card independently toggles Details / Hide details.
Evidence can refer to saved summary, key ideas, visual facts, or a quoted slide reference.
Further Insight is the second cue column. To clarify is conditional on the cue data.

frames.title: Cues · pending, offline, retry
notes: The status placeholder represents mutually exclusive source states: Requesting AI cues…, unavailable offline, outdated, not generated, disabled, source unavailable, failed, or needs confirmation.
Recovery controls appear only when the state offers the corresponding action; offline state has no recovery button.
An uncertain retry opens Retry AI cues? with Retry / Cancel and a possible-charge warning.
This frame groups conditional UI variants. Variant messages and recovery controls are not all visible at once.

frames.title: Rehearse · rotated PDF
notes: Only the PDF and associated labels/controls rotate; this is an in-screen view variant.
Cues, tick strip, and conventional large readout are hidden. Review gives way to the elapsed Time control.
Android Back returns the PDF to normal view before leaving the screen.
Rotation preserves the capture phase. Rotating back during recording keeps capture running; Stop uses the normal save flow.

frames.title: Record · countdown & starting
notes: Three-second countdown follows Record or confirmed Redo. Tapping during countdown cancels it.
After countdown the capture enters starting; record button and slide navigation are disabled while preparing.
The native microphone permission prompt may appear. Denial returns idle with the actual error.
This frame groups conditional UI variants. Variant messages and recovery controls are not all visible at once.

frames.title: Recording · live rehearsal
notes: Live readout shows elapsed time and current-slide time of its target.
Slides can move backward or forward while recording and preserve visit events.
Tap Stop ends capture; Review is disabled during capture.

frames.title: Saving · completion & route
notes: Saving is followed by a short completion/confetti state and automatic navigation. The diagram combines those adjacent transition states.
First saved take opens Full review. Later saved takes open Slide review. A redo with a candidate comparison opens Compare.
A failed stop/save returns idle with an error and retains honest recovery behavior.
This frame groups conditional UI variants. Variant messages and recovery controls are not all visible at once.

title: Redo, recovery & transcription permission
description: Capture replacement choices, interrupted recordings, and global provider dialogs.

frames.title: Redo slide · confirmation

blocks.text: Recording and transcript will be replaced
Compare takes and keep the old one

notes: This dialog opens when the selected slide already has a take and its redo button is tapped.
Replacement is reviewable through comparison after capture.

frames.title: Redo whole presentation

blocks.text: Compare with current run and keep either one

notes: Available when any run exists and capture is idle.
The hold progress ring triggers this confirmation; confirming moves to slide 1 and starts countdown.

frames.title: Interrupted recording · inspect entry
notes: Only unselected, undiscarded interrupted/capturing attempts are listed for recovery.
When several exist, the readout adds [x] of [N]; closing inspection advances the recovery cursor.

frames.title: Recording details · recover capture
notes: There is no generic Play control in this recovery sheet. The source has a progress readout and conditional recovery, transcription, and offline tools.
Recover recording appears only when interrupted local audio is loaded and playable.
Upload recording is conditional on local/upload-failed stage; transcription controls vary by stage. Recovery failure retains the original file.

frames.title: ElevenLabs · first-use permission

blocks.text: Saved audio and slide vocabulary hints
Through OutLoud server to Scribe v2
Audio and results remain on this phone

notes: Global dialog can cover any active app screen; rehearse is a schematic underlying route.
Continue allows automatic transcription after future recordings and continues all takes waiting on the same first-use disclosure.
Cancel declines the pending permission prompt.
The dialog does not navigate. D4 is an example originating underlay, not a guaranteed destination; it may instead cover Review or another active screen.

frames.title: Transcription · uncertain retry

blocks.text: Retry may send the audio again
Exactly one provider request is not guaranteed

notes: Shown when the previous transcription request has an uncertain outcome.
Continue acknowledges that another provider charge may occur. The underlying screen is illustrative because this dialog is global.
The dialog does not navigate. D4 is an example originating underlay, not a guaranteed destination; it may instead cover Review or another active screen.

title: Review & playback
description: Whole-run review, slide playback and confirmed transcript corrections.

frames.title: Full review
notes: Full review includes the Presentation score panel and transcript in one scroll region.
Slide tiles open selected-slide Review; downward navigation returns to incoming Home, Rehearse or Review.
Metrics and scores are placeholders, not claimed provider output.

transitions.label: Back when opened from Slide review

frames.title: Some run audio is missing

blocks.text: Audio for slide [n] is not on this phone.

notes: Dialog appears only when some run segments are playable and others are missing.
If every segment is missing, show a status note instead.
If selected recordings change while dialog is open, restart is required.

frames.title: Slide review

blocks.text: Times per slide · tap a bar
Slide audio + transcript · score · AI feedback [scroll]

notes: Full Review is a prominent header button.
Time bars select slides and show each selected score or status.
Return target depends on whether Review was opened from Full review.

transitions.label: Back when opened from Full review

frames.title: Slide audio & inline transcript

blocks.text: Swipe a movable sentence to an adjacent slide

notes: Play is disabled when audio is unavailable, duration is zero or no selected part exists.
Tapping a sentence or timestamp plays its original interval.
Boundary sentences preserve source audio; only movable lines can be reassigned.

frames.title: Transcription correction choices

blocks.text: Select a replacement, keep original, or close

notes: Replacement choices come from the actual suggestion; sample alternatives are placeholders.
Accepting saves confirmed correction then synchronizes; failure retains local edit.
A changed transcript invalidates an open selection. Corrected lines offer Restore original.
Applying a choice closes this panel before the saved-correction notice appears in the transcript.

frames.title: Correction synchronization conflict

blocks.text: Pending state: Saved on phone · sync pending

notes: Use server / Keep mine appear for an actual correction conflict.
Sync corrections appears for pending sync without conflict, disabled while busy.
Retry slide context is conditional on a suggestion dependency recovery action.
This frame groups conditional UI variants. Variant messages and recovery controls are not all visible at once.

title: Assessment & recording tools
description: Numeric score, verified findings, evidence, offline tools and recovery states.

frames.title: Score prose & cited evidence
notes: Shared panel is used in Review and Full review.
There is no radar chart or criteria chart rendered by this component.
Only current validated results expose their source evidence; score and text here are placeholders.
In Full review, cited audio plays in place with a status note; the Feedback evidence card is used by Slide review.

frames.title: Selected-slide AI feedback
notes: This selected-slide feedback is distinct from numeric scoring and recording-wide suggestions.
Finding count, categories, observation and advice are provider-result placeholders.
Further Insight appears only when enrichments exist.

frames.title: Finding details & source audio

blocks.text: Original audio interval; not synthesized audio

notes: Listen opens an inline evidence card and scrolls to it.
Playback is disabled when interval is invalid or local audio is unavailable.
An invalid interval message says original audio is retained.

frames.title: Recording tools & offline files
notes: Actions are conditional: upload local/failed upload, retry failed transcription, transcribe awaiting input.
Download audio and PDF appear only for available remote source specifications; busy actions are disabled.
PDF can report already available offline or no downloadable source.
Original transcript expands raw timed words in these tools and seeks the original audio; it stays separate from corrected sentence playback.

frames.title: Assessment stale / unavailable / retry

blocks.text: Previous request may have reached provider. Another charge is possible.

notes: This frame groups mutually exclusive recovery variants; they do not all render simultaneously.
Busy, unsynced requirements, unavailable provider or missing transcript can disable generation.
Stale results are withheld; retry charge acknowledgement appears only on uncertain prior outcome.
This frame groups conditional UI variants. Variant messages and recovery controls are not all visible at once.

frames.title: Speech / source unavailable states

blocks.text: [No speech / Uploading / Transcribing / No saved audio]

notes: These are alternative empty or recovery states, not fabricated successful output.
No-speech, no recording and text-without-word-timing have different explanations.
Unaligned text cannot be assigned to a slide; missing audio disables inline playback.
This frame groups conditional UI variants. Variant messages and recovery controls are not all visible at once.

title: Compare & descriptions
description: Keep or overwrite takes; inspect/edit slide context and acknowledge AI requests.

frames.title: Compare recordings

blocks.text: [Whole presentation / slide range] · choose one recording

notes: Keep current is the default selection; cards select the intended result.
Confirm resolves the choice and opens Full review for first saved take, otherwise Slide Review.
Hardware Back keeps current and returns Rehearse; no swipe navigation or card audio buttons.

frames.title: Recording-wide suggestions

blocks.text: Original recording scope · selected-slide feedback stays in Review

notes: Result displays up to three recording-wide suggestions.
Generation is disabled while busy, disclosure/retry prompt is open, a description draft is unsaved or provider is unavailable.
Upload and transcribe prerequisite appears instead when server deck context is absent.

frames.title: Slide descriptions accordion

blocks.text: Read/edit saved descriptions without requesting AI

notes: Each saved description has an expand/collapse control.
Edit is disabled while busy, consent/retry prompt is open or another draft exists.
No saved descriptions and loading are explicit alternatives.

frames.title: Description draft & conflict
notes: Each text label states 400 characters maximum.
Conflict disables Save and reveals Reload current version; Cancel discards only draft.
Saving makes existing AI suggestions stale; regeneration is explicit.
Reload current version refreshes the editable draft and keeps the editor open.
This frame groups conditional UI variants. Variant messages and recovery controls are not all visible at once.

frames.title: AI suggestions consent

blocks.text: Slide images/text, descriptions, transcript and audience context go through the server.

notes: Global AppShell dialog is raised by recording-wide coaching first-use disclosure.
Provider/model are rendered from the actual configured disclosure, not fixed invented values.
Cancel returns without submitting; Continue resumes the pending action.

frames.title: AI request uncertain retry

blocks.text: The previous provider request has an uncertain outcome.
Another request may incur another charge.

notes: Alternative actual dialogs: AppShell recording-wide suggestions says Request again? with Continue; Rehearse cue recovery says Retry AI cues? with Retry.
This overlay is separate from score, selected-slide feedback, transcription and Q&A retry controls.

title: Audience Q&A — answer capture
description: Prepare audience questions, hear prompts and record durable answer audio.

frames.title: Prepare audience questions
notes: Only buttons appropriate to the current prerequisite state appear.
Question preparation can wait for saved requirements synchronization or selected recording upload/transcription.
Retry/update is hidden while active generation is running or sources/settings are not ready.

frames.title: Audience question
notes: Tap question toggles text-to-speech.
Horizontal swipe navigates questions; down returns to Slide Review.
Last question omits Next and shows Last question · swipe down for your review.

frames.title: Answer countdown
notes: Countdown lasts three seconds and provides haptic selections.
Tapping again cancels; question navigation and back are blocked during countdown.
The microphone starts after countdown completes.

frames.title: Record answer
notes: Recording meters drive waveform and elapsed time.
Stop persists a new answer identity and audio before remote judging.
Navigation is blocked until capture ends; microphone/save errors are shown.

frames.title: Answer transcription consent

blocks.text: Saved answer audio + vocabulary hints go through OutLoud server to Scribe v2.
May incur provider charges; Continue permits future recordings and answers.
Cancel keeps saved audio without submitting.

notes: This is the Q&A-specific answer consent dialog.
Consent-save failure retains the answer and reports error.
A new recording was already saved before this modal.

frames.title: Saved answer · processing / retry

blocks.text: Your answer · [Transcribing/reviewing… OR review error · tap to retry]
On review error: tap to try again

notes: Saved audio remains playable while evaluation is pending.
A late response from an older rerecording cannot replace the newer answer.
Question sets and answer attempts persist for resumption.
After declined or failed consent, the saved answer remains on this same question with its error and retry control; no new question is generated.
The saved-audio control always remains. Pending evaluation and review-error rows are mutually exclusive variants.

title: Audience Q&A — review & continuation
description: Evidence-backed answer review, follow-ups, saved sessions and recovery.

frames.title: Answer evaluation
notes: Verdict, advice and transcript are placeholders for actual saved review output.
Too short instead explains insufficient duration and suggested 60–90 / 30–60 seconds.
Follow-up card appears only after a non-short evaluated primary answer and when follow-up exists.

frames.title: Follow-up question
notes: Tapping original question returns to primary question/answer.
Follow-up uses the same countdown, capture, saved audio, consent and evaluation flow.
Typical answer guidance is 30–60 seconds.

frames.title: Evaluated follow-up
notes: Follow-up evaluation shares verdict, evidence, clarification and transcript rendering with primary answer.
The saved primary answer remains available through Question · tap to go back.
No additional nested follow-up chain is rendered.

frames.title: Saved Q&A archive
notes: Archive cycles saved sets then returns to current Q&A.
Playback-only: Record/Redo and answer-retry action are absent.
Saved audience, questions and answers belong to the archived generation job.

frames.title: Q&A failure & prerequisite recovery

blocks.text:
[Prerequisite or failure explanation]
Saved recordings / answer retained

items: Tap failed answer to retry review

notes: Grouped variants: pending recording upload/transcription, dirty settings, missing audience, stale questions, slide-profile recovery or generation failure.
Failed answer review remains playable and tap-to-retry; retry is absent in archives.
Only actions applicable to the active variant appear.
This frame groups conditional UI variants. Variant messages and recovery controls are not all visible at once.

frames.title: Confirm uncertain Q&A retry

blocks.text: Previous request may have reached the provider and incurred a charge.

notes: Shared Q&A dialog handles uncertain question generation or answer evaluation.
Retry reuses saved input; it does not make a new recording.
Cancel dismisses the pending acknowledgement and retains saved content.
